page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single column, with the running head "BIBLICUS." and page number 155 at the top. Below the text, after a centred "XVII." and the heading "ARCHITECTONICA SACRA.", come two numbered theses (I, II), and the second ends with the word-break "Opor-". Line-count numbers in the left margin and the music staves at the left edge (show-through from the facing page) are not transcribed.

main_text.l: que hæc causa fuit, quòd in cultu legali adhibita fuerunt
diuersa organa: vt admonerentur non in aliis rebus frivolis
& ineptis, vt mundus facere solet, sed in celebra-
tione beneficiorum Dei oblectationes animorum esse
quærendas, atque huc studium omne esse referendum
Psal. 148. Et quemadmodum sunt varia Dei beneficia: sic
nostrum est subinde nova & varij generis carmina con-
dere, & concinere, tum voce, tum organis, in laudem
& honorem Dei, & domi, & in templo, & in campo.
Neque vero hoc modo paedagogia & infantia veteris po-
puli veluti postliminio introducitur. Non enim appara-
tum Leuiticæ musicæ in templa nostra inuehimus, sed
quantum excitandis animis satis est adhiberi volumus.
Coloss.3.v.16. Deinde musica debet seruire moderatæ hilari-
tati, & profligandæ melancholiæ. 1. Sam. 16.v.16.23. De-
nique harmonia musica debet nobis in memoriam redi-
gere harmoniam illam mundi, quæ cernitur inter cœ-
lum & elementa, inter facultates animæ, inter corpus &
animam, inter qualitates corporis: item egregiam illam
harmoniam, quæ fuit in homine, & inter hominem atq;
reliquas creaturas ante lapsum, quæque erit in altera vi-
ta. Vide quæ sub finem Poeticæ differuimus ex Athana-
sio de utilitate numerorum poëticorum. Uno verbo: Mu-
sica & harmonia, quæ cernitur in cantilenis, organis
musicis, & vocibus auicularum musicarum, nos admo-
nere debet de harmonia precum & virtutum.
XVII.
ARCHITECTONICA SACRA.
I. ARchitectonica sacra est bene ædificandi
scientia ex S. literis illustrata.
II. Eius partes duæ sunt: prima, de affectio-
nibus, altera, de exemplari operis extruendi.
Opor-

page.notes: Initial "A" of thesis I is a large ornamental letter, joined to "Rchitectonica" as "ARchitectonica". The "ARCHITECTONICA" heading has an ornamental initial, transcribed as plain "A". "Coloss." is printed with a ß-type ligature, transcribed as "Coloss.". The "poëticorum" in the Athanasius reference is slightly smudged but readable. Left-margin music staves are show-through from the facing page and are excluded.
